info.title: PosSaaS Cloud API
info.description: Branch gateway synchronization and read-only reports. Every error body is the envelope { "code", "message" }: clients act on `code`; `message` is human-readable (French). Out-of-scope and non-existent resources are both 404. Cloud users authenticate with a session cookie (/v1/auth, /v1/me); gateways and report keys are separate schemes.

post.summary: Register a gateway with a one-time provisioning code and proof of key possession.
Deliver the next contiguous batch of the authenticated gateway's branch events (idempotent).

get.summary: Confirmed events of the authenticated gateway's branch after a sequence (recovery).
Last sequence the cloud confirmed for the authenticated gateway's branch.

post.summary: Create an account (no tenant access). Same answer whether or not the address already has an account.
Confirm the address with the emailed single-use token.
Send a new verification link if the address has an unverified account (always 202).
Password step. Returns signed_in, or mfa_required with a short second-factor session.
Second step: a TOTP code or one recovery code. Starts a new full session.
Email a reset link if the address has a verified account (always 202).
Set a new password with the emailed token; ends every session.
Accept an owner invitation (verified, matching address and enabled MFA required).

get.summary: The signed-in user, MFA state and organization memberships.
Live sessions of the signed-in user.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the user's sessions (another user's session is 404).

post.summary: Revoke every session except the current one.
Change the password; other sessions end and this one is re-keyed.
New authenticator key (not active until confirmed).
Activate TOTP with a first code; returns recovery codes once.
Replace all recovery codes (current TOTP code required).
Turn MFA off (password + code; refused for organization owners).

get.summary: Organization summary: businesses and branches with sync freshness.
Business summary: its branches with sync freshness.
Synced orders of a branch, by number (status = open|submitted, limit 1..500).
Catalog last published by a branch gateway.

PosGateway.description: `PosGateway {gatewayId}:{unixSeconds}:{signature}`: ECDSA P-256 signature by the registered gateway key over method, path and query, timestamp and body SHA-256; valid ±5 minutes.
PosGateway.name: Authorization

ReportKey.description: Read-only report key scoped to an organization, a business or a branch.

Session.description: Cloud user session (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie set by login). Unsafe requests from a browser must come from the configured dashboard origin. 403 mfa_required: finish or enrol the second factor.
Session.name: __Host-pos_session
